expected.canonical_headline: St. Lucie County sheriff restricts license plate reader use to forcible felonies, missing-person cases
selected_headlines: St. Lucie County votes to remove license plate readers from county roads over privacy concerns
source_headlines: St. Lucie County votes to remove license plate readers over privacy concerns - WPBF
novel_facts: County commissioners voted 3-2 on Tuesday Sept. 2 to remove ALPRs from county roads and property
Commissioner James Clasby introduced the motion
Commissioners Erin Lowry and Jamie Fowler supported removal
Commissioner Cathy Townsend and one other dissented, wanting law enforcement input first
Decision extends beyond FDOT directive to include county-controlled rights of way
Vote includes halting new permits and potentially revoking existing permits
Police Chief John Bolduc announced operational pause on ALPRs
